_doc: Pronunciation fixes, applied to the spoken text only (subtitles keep the original). Keys are whole words, case-sensitive. A [[…]] value is raw IPA (Kokoro, Azure). '<lang>@<engine>' entries override '<lang>' for one engine. Use the narration-lexicon skill to find and verify entries. French: Kokoro reads 'Home Assistant' as 'hommes assistants', hence the respelling; ATW-IOT-01 needs a pause between letters.

en.ATW-IOT-01: A T W, I O T, zero one

fr.ATW-IOT-01: A, T, W, I, O, T, zéro un,
